concerns.text: Task T005 states: "Because the reward dataset is unavailable and participant‑ID matching across studies is impossible, the pipeline automatically selects a Between‑Subjects design." This pre‑emptively assumes ID mismatch without performing the required detection step, violating FR‑007 (detect ID mismatch) and FR‑008 (report design type based on actual data). The task weakens the specification by narrowing the design choice without verification.

Task T007 description relies on the design set by T005 and runs a One‑Way ANOVA "Because the design is Between‑Subjects..." It inherits the same assumption and therefore does not implement the required design‑aware logic that would run a Repeated‑Measures ANOVA if IDs match, further violating FR‑007/FR‑008.
